name: Nine-point circle theorem contributed to Mathlib (coordinate-free)

insights: The nine-point circle is translation-covariant, so the circumcenter can be normalised to the origin: with a = A−O, b = B−O, c = C−O and ‖a‖=‖b‖=‖c‖=R, the nine-point centre is (a+b+c)/2 and the radius is R/2. Every membership reduces to a statement about a,b,c.

Six of the nine points are essentially free: N − (side midpoint) and N − (vertex-orthocenter midpoint) are each ±(1/2)·(one of a,b,c), so their distance to N is exactly R/2 with no inner-product computation and no nondegeneracy hypothesis — they lie on the circle even for collinear triangles.

Only the three altitude feet use the inner-product structure. The foot of the altitude from a onto line bc is F = b + t·(c−b), t = ⟪a−b,c−b⟫/⟪c−b,c−b⟫; a direct expansion gives ‖N−F‖² = R²/4, with the cancellation resting on ⟪a−b+c,a−b+c⟫ = R²+2⟪a−b,c−b⟫ and ⟪a−b+c,c−b⟫ = ⟪a−b,c−b⟫ + (1/2)⟪c−b,c−b⟫.

Substituting the denominator value ⟪c−b,c−b⟫ = 2R²−2⟪b,c⟫ BEFORE expanding lets field_simp clear the single division (needing R²−⟪b,c⟫ ≠ 0) and reduces the goal to a polynomial identity ring closes — geometry becomes algebra.

All three altitude feet follow from a single core lemma: lift to general circumcenter by translation (dist_sub_right) and permute the vertices using that the nine-point centre is symmetric in A,B,C (ninePointCenter_rotate).

Axiom hygiene: #print axioms ninePoints_mem_sphere = [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] only — 0 axioms, no sorryAx, no Lean.ofReduceBool (no native_decide). Mathlib has no nine-point circle, so this is new infrastructure.

mathlibGaps: Mathlib has no nine-point circle / Feuerbach circle and no orthocenter-as-A+B+C−2O identity packaged for general inner product spaces; this file supplies a self-contained coordinate-free version.

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETE: coordinate-free nine-point circle theorem in any real InnerProductSpace. For an arbitrary triangle A B C with common circumcenter O (dist O A = dist O B = dist O C = R), the three side midpoints, three vertex-orthocenter midpoints, and three altitude feet all lie on Metric.sphere ((A+B+C−O)/2) (R/2). 14 theorems / 4 defs, verified 0 sorries / 0 axioms (only propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound; no native_decide). Generalises the gallery's coordinate (Point = ℝ×ℝ) Feuerbach proofs and the single-triangle sphere bridge of feuerbachs-theorem-defs-oq-04. Verified offline via lake env lean (EXIT 0, #print axioms clean). PR opened.
